title: JustLogic: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Deductive Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2501.14851v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Logical reasoning is a critical component of Large Language Models (LLMs), and substantial research efforts in recent years have aimed to enhance their deductive reasoning abilities. However, existing deductive reasoning benchmarks suffer from significant constraints that restrict their utility, i.e., the lack of task complexity, the presence of prior knowledge as a confounder, and superficial error analysis. translated_title: JustLogic：一个用于评估大型语言模型演绎推理能力的综合基准
translated_abstract: 逻辑推理是大型语言模型（LLM）的关键组成部分，近年来大量研究工作致力于提升其演绎推理能力。然而，现有的演绎推理基准存在显著局限，限制了其实用价值，即缺乏任务复杂性、存在先验知识作为混淆因素，以及错误分析流于表面。为了解决这些缺陷，我们提出了JustLogic，一个用于评估命题逻辑演绎能力的合成生成基准。在这一逻辑片段范围内，JustLogic具有以下特点：(i) 复杂性，能够生成多样化的语言模式、词汇和论证结构；(ii) 与先验知识无关，大幅降低了具备先验知识的模型所拥有的优势，使所有问题仅凭给定前提即可作答；(iii) 能够对异构的推理错误进行深入的错误分析。
tldr: JustLogic是一个合成生成的命题逻辑演绎推理基准，兼具任务复杂性、先验知识无关性和深入错误分析能力，克服了现有基准的三大局限。
en_tdlr: JustLogic is a synthetically generated benchmark for evaluating propositional logic deduction that is complex, prior knowledge independent, and capable of in-depth error analysis, addressing key limitations of existing deductive reasoning benchmarks.
